# Context Crystal: Comprehensive Machine-Readable Corpus (llms-full.txt)

> **Context Crystal** — Sovereign, Deterministic, Local-First Context and DAG Lifecycle Engine.
> Version: 1.1.0
> License: MIT
> Specification: JSON Schema v1 (`spec/v1/context-crystal.json`) with JSON-LD semantics.
> Repository: https://github.com/oswaldo/context-crystal

---

## 1. Core Architectural Concepts

### 1.1 The Cave (.ccrystals/)
A workspace container housing:
- `crystal.json`: Canonical state file for each active crystal.
- `entities.json`: Shared multi-entity authorship registry.
- `artifacts.json`: Shared cave-level virtual and physical artifact inventory.
- `.ccrystals/archive/<id>/`: Cold storage repository for concluded, frozen crystals preserving full lineage.
- Derived Markdown views (`tasks.md`, `lessons-learned.md`, `transient.json`) auto-projected for human inspection.
- Companion store support via `CCRYSTAL_STORE` environment variable or `.ccrystal-store` pointer file.

### 1.2 The Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG)
Causal state transitions recorded immutably:
- `nodeId`: Deterministic or random UUID / prefix identifier.
- `parentIds`: Parents in the causal lattice.
- `timestamp`: Explicit ISO-8601 UTC event timestamp.
- `authorId`: Entity attribution (`usr_operator`, `agt_antigravity`).
- `kind`: `init`, `prompt`, `reasoning`, `action`, `checkpoint`, `tool_call`, `tool_result`, `error`, `resolution`.
- `captureFidelity`: `inferred` (synthesized by agent) or `intercepted` (deterministic kernel event).
- `anchor`: Optional human-readable semantic label for sub-DAG slicing.
- `inputArtifactIds`, `outputArtifactIds`, `preconditionArtifactIds`: Explicit links to artifacts.

### 1.3 Transient Resource Leases
Guaranteed elimination of agent debris:
- `resourceType`: `git_worktree`, `mock_service`, `temp_directory`, `configuration_patch`.
- `disposalPolicy`: `revert_on_conclusion`, `delete_after_test`, `replace_in_final_cut`, `manual`.
- Invariant: A crystal goal cannot be marked Concluded while active leases remain uncleaned or unpromoted.

### 1.4 Artifact & World-State Ontology
Bridging digital deliberation with physical and virtual reality:
- `substrate`: `virtual` (code repos, schemas, APIs) or `physical` (hardware benches, test rigs).
- `role`: `target` (deliverable), `instrument` (measurement tool), `precondition` (required environment).
- Physical location: Civic address, RFC 5870 `geo:` URI, bench/room coordinates.

---

## 2. Verified CLI Command Reference

```bash
# General AI Guidance
ccrystal --for-ai

# Crystal Lifecycle
ccrystal init <id> -g "<title>" -i "<intent>" [-t "<task>"]...
ccrystal list [--status in_progress|concluded] [--archived] [--json]
ccrystal conclude <id> -s <in_progress|concluded_success|concluded_abandoned> [-r "<reason>"]
ccrystal delete <id> [--force]
ccrystal refresh <id>

# Cave Hygiene & Archiving
ccrystal triage [--solid|--stale|--active] [--json]
ccrystal archive <id>
ccrystal unarchive <id>

# Tasks (Acceptance Criteria)
ccrystal task add <id> -d "<description>"
ccrystal task done <id> -t <task-id>

# DAG Transitions & Deterministic Melting
ccrystal node add <id> -k <kind> -s "<summary>" [--author <id>] [--fidelity <fidelity>] [--anchor <label>]
ccrystal melt <id> --from <anchor> --to <anchor> [-s "<summary>"]

# Context Hydration & Beam Shaping
ccrystal hydrate <id> [--tail <N>] [--from <anchor>] [--to <anchor>] [--depth <N>] [--summary-only]
ccrystal cast <id> ... (alias for hydrate)

# Transient Leases
ccrystal transient lease <id> -t <type> [-p <path>] -d "<desc>" --policy <policy>
ccrystal transient clean <id> -l <lease-id>

# Slicing & Cleavage
ccrystal slice <id> [--from <anchor>] [--to <anchor>] [--fork-to <child-id>] [--prune]

# Entity Registry
ccrystal entity list
ccrystal entity register --id <id> --name "<name>" --kind <human|agent>
ccrystal entity deregister <id> [--force]

# Lessons Learned
ccrystal lesson add <id> -f "<friction>" -r "<root-cause>" -a "<action>"
ccrystal lesson resolve <id> -l <lesson-id>
ccrystal lesson list <id>

# Artifact Registry
ccrystal artifact list [--cave] [--crystal <id>]
ccrystal artifact register --id <id> --name "<name>" --substrate <virtual|physical> --role <target|instrument|precondition> [--uri <uri>] [--location-name <name>] [--geo-uri <geo>] [--bench-coords <coords>]
ccrystal artifact inspect <id>

# Batch Execution (Universal Escape Hatch)
ccrystal batch "cmd1; cmd2; cmd3"

# Native MCP Server
ccrystal mcp
```

---

## 3. Model Context Protocol (MCP) Tools

Native stdio JSON-RPC 2.0 endpoint started via `ccrystal mcp`.

| Tool Name | Key Arguments | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `crystal_init` | `id`, `goal_title`, `intent`, `tasks?` | Instantiate crystal with atomic criteria |
| `crystal_search` | `query?`, `since?`, `until?`, `status?`, `aging?`, `sort?`, `limit?`, `offset?` | Navigate crystals across metadata, DAG, and date bounds with pagination |
| `crystal_stats` | `filter?`, `detailed?`, `json_output?` | Workspace health metrics, temporal genesis, disk usage, and token savings |
| `crystal_hydrate` | `crystal_id`, `tail?`, `from?`, `to?`, `summary_only?` | Context beam shaping for LLM prompts |
| `crystal_triage` | `filter?`, `json_output?` | Deterministic aging hygiene categorization |
| `crystal_artifact` | `action`, `id?`, `name?`, `substrate?`, `role?`, `uri?` | Manage virtual/physical artifacts |
| `crystal_checkpoint` | `crystal_id`, `summary`, `fidelity?` | Append DAG checkpoint node |
| `crystal_task_transition` | `crystal_id`, `task_id`, `status` | Transition acceptance criterion |
| `crystal_goal_transition` | `crystal_id`, `status`, `reason?` | Transition crystal goal lifecycle state |
| `crystal_transient_lease` | `crystal_id`, `resource_type`, `path?`, `policy` | Acquire ephemeral resource lease |
| `crystal_slice_fork` | `source_id`, `fork_to`, `from?`, `to?`, `prune?` | Cleave and fork sub-DAG into child |
| `crystal_melt` | `crystal_id`, `from`, `to`, `summary?` | Deterministically squash sub-DAG segment into checkpoint |
| `crystal_archive` | `crystal_id` | Move concluded crystal to cold storage archive |
| `crystal_unarchive` | `crystal_id` | Restore archived crystal to workspace cave |
| `crystal_delete` | `crystal_id`, `force?` | Permanent deletion with impact check |
| `crystal_batch` | `commands` | Multi-command recipe separated by `;` |

### MCP Resources
- `ccrystal://artifacts`: Cave-level artifact registry
- `ccrystal://{crystal_id}/artifacts`: Crystal-scoped deliverables and instruments
- `ccrystal://entities`: Workspace entity registry

---

## 4. Entity Behavioral Guidelines & PII Protection

1. **Synthetic PII Invariant:** Never emit real personal data or identifiable company credentials.
   - Use RFC 2606 reserved domains (`example.com`, `example.org`).
   - Use standard neutral fictitious entities (`Acme Corp`, `Example Industries`).
   - Use standard neutral cultural placeholders (e.g. *John Doe*, *Max Mustermann*, *Fulano de Tal*).
2. **Dual-Credential Security & Push Gate:**
   - Commit signing key (`user.signingkey`): AI entities create local cryptographically signed commits within worktrees.
   - Remote transport key (`git push`): Remotely authenticated via passphrase or hardware security token (YubiKey) held strictly by the human operator. Autonomous entities NEVER execute `git push` autonomously.
3. **Secret Sanitization Invariant (Pointers Over Values):**
   - Never record raw secrets, passwords, or private API keys into DAG nodes or envelopes.
   - Use environment variable pointers (`env:VAR_NAME`) and zero-secret postures.
4. **Proud Human-in-the-Loop Craftsmanship:**
   - Strictly reject runaway agent swarms and synthetic slop.
   - All state transitions, architecture, and code modifications are engineered in deliberate human partnership.
5. **Atomic Storage & OCC Invariant:**
   - All disk mutations execute via atomic POSIX `rename(2)` / `REPLACE_EXISTING` swaps with 128-bit `ContentFingerprint` CAS rebase loops, preventing concurrent race conditions.
